name: mail-dns
description: Trinity Mail DNS manifest + verify: the tenant-side mirror of the relay onboard script. Generates a provider-neutral mail-dns.yaml of copy-paste SPF/DKIM/DMARC/bounce records (SPF via include: of the relay, never a hardcoded IP) for one or more sending domains, plus a node:dns verify script that checks every record is published and aligned
postMessage: Installed to ./mail-dns. 1) (Optional) author mail-dns/mail-dns.config.ts (export default a MailDnsConfig) — or edit the inline defaults; see mail-dns/mail-dns.example.yaml for the ozean-licht.com worked example. SPF MUST stay an include: of the relay SPF domain, never a hardcoded IP. 2) Generate the manifest: `npx tsx mail-dns/generate.ts` (writes mail-dns/mail-dns.yaml). 3) Publish each name/type/value record at your DNS provider (Hostinger for OL); the DKIM public key is published by `trinity-mail init`. 4) Verify publication + alignment: `npx tsx mail-dns/verify.ts` (OK/!! per record, exit 1 if any fail). Start SPF ~all / DMARC p=none during warmup, then harden to -all / quarantine→reject. Pairs with mail-client, mail-templates, mail-webhook, mail-tresor. Tests: `npx vitest run mail-dns`.
